objective: Prepare only the separate static method freeze for offline public synthetic shadow-boundary and review-memory correctness; preparation approval is not freeze or runtime acceptance.

rules.statement: The normative method is docs/governance/gnc-phase-3a-shadow-method.md at the separately accepted freeze head. Input canonical SHA256 is 47f70d04ebf58cc60936488893890b58eb3b5b26890588365b39a7d281096fc6; expected canonical SHA256 is 3d8b79a812e023fad51cf1ebfec8b83384b11a66edcbef6a6e401782f46b9205. Both are static definitions, not generated runtime evidence.

Only the five new allowlisted static files may change; all existing paths and all other new paths are forbidden. No runtime, reports, model/provider/network access, live ingestion, verdict caching or automatic actions.
Fixed synthetic candidates cannot create rules, confirmations, dispositions, waivers or authority. Synthetic source authority is an explicit fixture trust assumption, not authentication.

Unresolved findings remain visible across snapshots. Thread state does not establish remediation. Resolution requires a current applicable synthetic authorized disposition and executed passing exact-head exact-target evidence.

Exact structured identity may link source records without removing them or resolving the underlying finding. Paraphrase requires confirmation. Different failure mode, conflict and recurrence are not collapsed.

Dispositions and waivers bind finding, head, contract, scope and explicit time; actor text alone is not authority. Every current snapshot is assessed fully; historical evidence never silently inherits applicability.
Changed base, head, merge-base, policy, contract, evaluator, paths or relevant context invalidates reuse. Rename/delete and cross-file inventories remain mandatory; incomplete inputs refuse.
Unknown fields, malformed values, exceeded limits and incomplete inputs refuse without truncation. Instruction-like permitted text remains inert; no source text is executed.

Sequence, predecessor references, uniqueness and any supplied event digest must agree. Divergent or incomplete history refuses. All source events remain inspectable; hashes do not prove authenticity or non-equivocation.

Expected decisions are written from method rules before runtime and unavailable to future runtime. Static checks do not adjudicate or establish future runtime correctness. Later guard-removal tests and positive controls are mandatory.

Report raw counts, denominators, abstentions and wording-family groups without invented rates for empty denominators. Hand-authored candidates cannot establish model quality, performance, savings or operational readiness.

Existing Phase1/2 semantics, policy, workflow, dependency or provider must change.
Inputs require private data, live reviews, model calls, external processing, credentials, source execution or new bill.
